summary: Verified granular favorites (mppt:<i>, phase:<L>), favorites order follows config array, native drag-and-drop reorder (mouse-based) with server persistence, and SunTimeline bar/arc toggle. All 4 target features pass end-to-end.
seed_data_creation: Reset favorites to [] via PUT /api/config after testing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Granular favorite keys ('mppt:<idx>', 'phase:<L1|L2|L3>') and whole-device keys ('shelly','ahoy','trucki','victron') all persist as literal strings in config.favorites. Pin testids: mppt-pin-<i>, shelly-<L>-pin, section-<x>-pin. Favorite tile testids use colon->hyphen (favorite-tile-mppt-0, favorite-tile-phase-L1). Tiles render in the EXACT order of config.favorites (verified with two different orders). Native HTML5 DnD on the tile body works via Playwright page.mouse down/move/up (not drag_to): reorder is persisted to /api/config and survives reload. SunTimeline: bar view (sun-timeline-bar) has sun-marker-day visible; sun-marker-night only present at night. Toggle sun-view-bogen->sun-timeline-svg and sun-view-balken->sun-timeline-bar works, persisted via localStorage 'suntimeline-view'.

test_results_detail.persist_after_reload: server favorites=['mppt:0','phase:L1'], tiles present after reload
test_results_detail.unpin_via_tile: mppt-0 tile removed after clicking favorite-unpin-mppt-0
test_results_detail.unpin_via_section_pin: phase-L1 tile removed after re-clicking shelly-L1-pin
test_results_detail.order_follows_array_1: PUT ['victron','phase:L1','mppt:0','trucki'] -> tiles rendered in that exact order
test_results_detail.order_follows_array_2: PUT ['mppt:0','trucki','victron','phase:L1'] -> tiles rendered in that exact order
test_results_detail.dnd_mouse: Dragged tile body with mouse down/move/up -> order changed to ['trucki','victron','mppt:0','phase:L1'], persisted server-side, survived reload
test_results_detail.suntimeline_toggle: balken->bogen->balken works, sun-marker-day present on bar
